name: 15367 · Venetia, PA
findings: ZIP 15367 (Venetia) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15367 (Venetia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 15367 (Venetia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
